all.name: Magik
all.description: Trained in dark arts and wielding her mighty Soulsword, Magik leaps through portals to navigate the arena with ease. Once Illyana transforms into the demonic Darkchild, all those who dare stand against her will fall before her merciless blade.

item.name: Demonic Cleave
item.description: Swipe across the frontal area with Soulsword to inflict damage on enemies.

item.name: Soulsword
item.description: Slash forward with the Soulsword.

additional_fields.Damage_Falloff: Falloff begins at 4.5m, decreasing to 50% at 6.5m

item.name: Soulsword
item.description: Slash forward with the Soulsword.

additional_fields.Damage_Falloff: Falloff begins at 4.5m, decreasing to 50% at 6.5m

item.name: Magik Slash
item.description: Strike forward an air slash. Each enemy hit reduces the cooldown of <Orange>Stepping Discs</>.

additional_fields.Damage: 45 - 90 (Maximum damage is achieved after 1.2s of charging)
additional_fields.Casting: Charged projectile that travels in a straight trajectory
additional_fields.Special_Effect: Projectile pierces enemies and reduces Stepping Discs cooldown by 1s per enemy pierced

item.name: Limbo's Might
item.description: Convert damage inflicted on enemies into <Buff>Bonus Health</> to herself.

additional_fields.Energy_Cost_Special_Effect: Convert damage taken into Bonus Health

item.name: Stepping Discs
item.description: Jump through a Stepping Disc, teleporting a short distance in the direction of movement. Become <Buff>Invincible</> while teleporting.

additional_fields.Special_Effect_2: Magik can perform a combo ability within a certain time frame, choosing between Eldritch Whirl or Demon's Rage

item.description: Spin while swinging the Soulsword after exiting a <Orange>Stepping Disc</>.

additional_fields.Range: A cylindrical spell field with a radius of 6m and a height of 5m
additional_fields.Casting: A cylindrical spell field in melee range
